event.title: Ecology, Evolution, Behavior, & Organismal Biology (EEBOB) seminar series
event.stream_info: To be granted access to the live Q&A session, interested attendees should email Dr. Todd Pierson. The live Q&A session will be held each Thursday at 9:35 AM.
event.description:
Speaker: Dr. Rachel Swenie, Fungal Curator @ New York Botanical Garden
Title: “What can herbarium collections teach us about fungi? Examples from chanterelle mushrooms and allies."
Abstract:  Dr. Rachel Swenie is the Assistant Curator of Mycology at the New York Botanical Garden. She earned her BFA from Columbia College and her PhD in Ecology and Evolutionary Biology from the University of Tennessee Knoxville, and she was a postdoc at the Farlow Herbarium at Harvard University. Rachel's talk is a great introduction to the wonderful world of fungi—and how important museum and herbarium collections are for informing our studies of the biodiversity. Come to learn more about genetic analyses, weird mushrooms, and what it's like to work at an herbarium.

 

The Ecology, Evolution, Behavior, & Organismal Biology (EEBOB) seminar series focuses on biological topics at the scale of whole organisms, their ecology, and the evolutionary relationships among them. Guest speakers come from universities, governmental agencies, NGOs, zoos, museums, and other institutions. The EEBOB seminar is an opportunity to learn about career paths and research in the biology discipline and for students to engage with professionals in a wide variety of biology careers.

 

This seminar series consists of a pre-recorded seminar, which will be posted to a playlist the beginning of each week, and a live, virtual Q&A session with the speaker. All are welcome to attend! To be granted access to the live Q&A session, interested attendees should email Dr. Todd Pierson. The live Q&A session will be held each Thursday at 9:35 AM.

event.description:
Your tour of the Kennesaw Campus includes a information session that covers topics ranging from campus majors and programs, admission requirements, and financial aid information, and will highlight The Bagwell College of Education. The information session will be followed by a 60-minute walking tour of the Kennesaw Campus.

After your campus tour, you are invited to a special tour of the Bagwell College of Education. The Bagwell College is one of the largest and strongest education programs in Georgia offering bachelors, masters, specialists, and doctor of education degree programs. Our programs are accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC) and the Georgia Professional Standards Commission (GaPSC). We offer an extensive array of distinctive programs to prepare you to enter the classroom ready to impact the future! You will love our faculty and staff. They are caring, compassionate and committed to your success!
